name: labsetu
description: LabSetu — an India-first, audit-grade Laboratory Information Management System

scripts.infra:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d
scripts.build: npm run build -w @labsetu/contracts && npm run build -w @labsetu/db && npm run build -w @labsetu/api && npm run build -w @labsetu/gateway && npm run build -w @labsetu/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @labsetu/api" "npm run dev -w @labsetu/web"
scripts.bootstrap: npm install && npm run db:generate && npm run build -w @labsetu/contracts
scripts.vercel:build:api: prisma generate --schema packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma && npm run build -w @labsetu/contracts && npm run build -w @labsetu/crypto && npm run build -w @labsetu/db && tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.json
scripts.vercel:build:web: prisma generate --schema packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma && npm run build -w @labsetu/contracts && npm run build -w @labsetu/crypto && npm run build -w @labsetu/db && npm run build -w @labsetu/web
